meaning: Exploratory protocol declared before curve measurements. Same identities/all automatic axes; seed only at the first previously observed native body center. No new candidate, manual angle, product tip relocation or rendering.
policy: Require prior complete axis, sampled body and anchor association. Predict half-pixel steps, measure bounded local transverse center with original margin, reject boundary/one-sided/competing/flat/weak centers. Require bilateral support at every <=.25native sample connecting successive centers. Update tangent by TLS only after >=2native arc of new observations; use most recent2native arc and reject turns>15degrees. Stop on first failure, never resume/bridge. Budgets and thresholds are engineering limits, not calibrated ownership/endpoint confidence. Local multiple-valley rejection is not a full branch detector. Every outcome remains UNKNOWN; stopping is never an ending.
